visualCharacteristics.purpose: A list of FAQ questions that expand to reveal their answers

cells.name: Question
cells.content: question text (plain text or a heading)

cells.name: Answer
cells.content: rich text answer, or a single link to a /fragments/ page to load complex content

contentPattern.structure: one row per question; cell 1 = question text, cell 2 = answer (rich text, or a single link to a /fragments/ page to load complex content such as nested blocks)

usage.description: FAQ sections: short questions with a rich-text answer revealed on click, marked by a plus/minus toggle and divider rules between items.

reuseGuidance: Use for any collapsible question/answer list. For complex answers (images, nested blocks), author the answer in a fragment and put a single link to it in the answer cell.
